description: Summary figure: ASNSD1 domain architecture, structure-mapped active-site residues with vertebrate conservation, the Glu348-equivalent position, and the tunnel test
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size':8,'axes.titlesize':9,'figure.dpi':140})
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[0.8,1.5,1.0],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.26)

# ---- A: domain architecture (InterPro, retrieved this run) ----
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
arch={"E. coli AsnB (554 aa)":[(554,[(2,186,"GATase-II",'#4C78A8'),(211,457,"Asn synthase (PF00733)",'#F58518')])],
      "Human ASNS (561 aa)":[(561,[(2,191,"GATase-II",'#4C78A8'),(235,539,"Asn synthase (PF00733)",'#F58518')])],
      "Human ASNSD1 (643 aa)":[(643,[(2,184,"GATase-II",'#4C78A8'),(320,608,"cd01991 AS-B C-term",'#F58518')])]}
for k,(nm,v) in enumerate(arch.items()):
    L,doms=v[0]; y=2-k
    axA.add_patch(Rectangle((0,y-0.16),L,0.32,fc='#E8E8E8',ec='#999',lw=0.6))
    for s,e,lab,c in doms:
        axA.add_patch(Rectangle((s,y-0.26),e-s,0.52,fc=c,ec='none',alpha=0.85))
        axA.text((s+e)/2,y,lab,ha='center',va='center',color='w',fontsize=7.2,fontweight='bold')
    axA.text(-12,y,nm,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=8)
# mark catalytic positions
for k,(nm,pos) in enumerate([("AsnB",[(2,'C2'),(349,'E349')]),("ASNS",[(2,'C2'),(365,'E365')]),("ASNSD1",[(2,'C2'),(494,'I494')])]):
    y=2-k
    for p,lab in pos:
        ok = not lab.startswith('I')
        axA.plot([p],[y+0.42],marker='v',ms=5,color='#2E7D32' if ok else '#C62828')
        axA.text(p,y+0.56,lab,ha='center',fontsize=6.6,color='#2E7D32' if ok else '#C62828')
axA.set_xlim(-180,700); axA.set_ylim(-0.6,2.95); axA.set_yticks([]); axA.set_xlabel("residue")
axA.set_title("A  Domain architecture (InterPro/CDD). Green = catalytic residue retained, red = lost",loc='left')
for s in ['top','right','left']: axA.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- B: site-by-site mapping with vertebrate conservation ----
rows=[("Gln",2,"C","C1 (Ntn nucleophile)","C",99.1,438),
      ("Gln",57,"R","R49 (Gln alpha-COO-)","R",99.0,99),
      ("Gln",63,"Q","Q60","Q",100.0,85),
      ("Gln",75,"W","V73","V",100.0,79),
      ("Gln",76,"N","N74 (oxyanion)","N",100.0,82),
      ("Gln",77,"G","G75 (oxyanion)","G",100.0,134),
      ("Gln",78,"E","E76","E",100.0,76),
      ("Gln",91,"D","D98","D",100.0,73),
      ("ATP",325,"L","L232 (AMP)","L",100.0,80),
      ("ATP",327,"S","S234 (SGGLDS)","S",100.0,314),
      ("ATP",328,"G","G235","G",100.0,348),
      ("ATP",329,"G","G236","G",100.0,313),
      ("ATP",330,"I","L237","L",87.6,395),
      ("ATP",331,"D","D238","D",100.0,398),
      ("ATP",332,"S","S239","S",100.0,398),
      ("ATP",492,"T","S346 (AMP ribose)","S",93.0,384),
      ("ATP",493,"G","G347 (AMP amide)","G",100.0,429),
      ("ATP",494,"I","E348 (beta-Asp-AMP)","E",94.4,429),
      ("ATP",497,"D","D351","D",100.0,439),
      ("ATP",533,"N","D384","D",100.0,439)]
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
labs=[f"{r[2]}{r[1]}" for r in rows]; x=np.arange(len(rows))
same=[r[2]==r[4] for r in rows]; cons=[r[5] for r in rows]
cols=['#2E7D32' if s else '#C62828' for s in same]
axB.bar(x,cons,color=cols,width=0.68)
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    axB.text(i,cons[i]+1.5,f"{cons[i]:.0f}",ha='center',fontsize=6.3)
    axB.text(i,-9,r[3],ha='right',va='top',rotation=55,fontsize=6.2,
             color='#2E7D32' if same[i] else '#C62828')
axB.set_xticks(x); axB.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=7.2,fontweight='bold')
axB.set_ylim(0,112); axB.set_ylabel("% identical across\nvertebrate ASNSD1 orthologs")
axB.axvline(7.5,color='k',lw=0.8,ls='--')
axB.text(3.5,106,"glutaminase (GATase-II) site",ha='center',fontsize=8,fontweight='bold')
axB.text(14,106,"synthetase (ATP) site",ha='center',fontsize=8,fontweight='bold')
axB.set_title("B  ASNSD1 residues mapped onto the 1CT9 glutamine and AMP sites (structural superposition),\n"
              "     coloured by whether the E. coli AS-B chemistry is retained (green) or changed (red). "
              "Bar height = conservation in 442 vertebrate ASNSD1 orthologs.",loc='left')
for s in ['top','right']: axB.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- C: position 494 / 365 residue distribution ----
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
d1={'I':405,'M':16,'L':4,'V':3,'T':1}; asn={'E':376}
order=['E','D','I','M','L','V','T']
w=0.38
axC.bar(np.arange(len(order))-w/2,[d1.get(a,0) for a in order],w,color='#C62828',label='ASNSD1 pos 494 (n=429 sp.)')
axC.bar(np.arange(len(order))+w/2,[asn.get(a,0) for a in order],w,color='#2E7D32',label='ASNS pos 365 (n=376 sp.)')
axC.set_xticks(range(len(order))); axC.set_xticklabels(order)
axC.set_ylabel("species"); axC.legend(fontsize=6.8,frameon=False)
axC.set_title("C  Residue equivalent to AS-B Glu348, which is\n     required for beta-aspartyl-AMP formation (PMID 20853825)",loc='left')
for s in ['top','right']: axC.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- D: tunnel test ----
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
clear=[2.8,2.4,2.0]
ecoli=[0,28.4,27.1]; d1t=[0,0,37.2]
axD.bar(np.arange(3)-0.19,ecoli,0.38,color='#4C78A8',label='E. coli AS-B 1CT9 (control)')
axD.bar(np.arange(3)+0.19,d1t,0.38,color='#E45756',label='ASNSD1 AlphaFold model')
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(ecoli,d1t)):
    if a==0: axD.text(i-0.19,1.2,"closed",ha='center',fontsize=6.5,rotation=90)
    if b==0: axD.text(i+0.19,1.2,"closed",ha='center',fontsize=6.5,rotation=90)
axD.set_xticks(range(3)); axD.set_xticklabels([f"{c} A" for c in clear])
axD.set_xlabel("probe clearance from heavy-atom centres")
axD.set_ylabel("buried path length, Gln site to\nAMP alpha-phosphate (A)")
axD.legend(fontsize=6.8,frameon=False,loc='upper left')
axD.set_title("D  Buried-cavity connectivity between the two sites",loc='left')
for s in ['top','right']: axD.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
